name: BeeOPP
description: An East African opportunity app for source-checked adverts, free accounts, and saved opportunities.

paragraphs: BeeOPP is an early public web app that helps people explore source-checked work opportunities across East Africa. Browsing and seeker accounts are free. BeeOPP links applicants to the original publisher; it does not accept applications or charge people to apply.
